method.name: Bayesian representation efficiency + elite proximity + rarity
method.evidence_shrinkage: Score is shrunk toward neutral 50 for small car samples.
method.bop_role: BoP-aware and multi-group. The current race group selects an isolated group table, and the circuit selects HIGH/MID/LOW. Technical variables are learned separately for each group + speed-class model.
